_note: Rules as data. Each rule is stored in Elastic as a percolator query (index unstep-rules) and also used in process. status 'reviewed' means a person read the FAA paragraph and agrees it governs this instruction; 'candidate' means it came from a search or an agent and has not been reviewed; 'needs_review' has no paragraph yet. Only the status changes how the card words the citation. Fill and review from data/faa with scripts/build_rule_table.py, never from memory.

rules.title: Taxi and Ground Movement Operations
rules.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-25 against the JO 7110.65 text in unstep-faa (Rishit decided). 3-7-2 is the rule because it holds the requirement Unstep enforces: 'Request a read back of runway hold short instructions when it is not received from the pilot/vehicle operator' (phraseology READ BACK HOLD INSTRUCTIONS), with the example 'hold short of Runway Two Three Left, traffic one mile final' after 'ready for departure'. Related: 3-7-4 Runway Proximity gives the general HOLD SHORT OF (runway), (traffic) phraseology, which is why the reranker ranks it first (1.443 vs 1.238)
